title: Flow replay
description: Every event in time order, stepped through the machines one at a time, across the whole history or along one item, so the person can watch an item move from request to the end. Reads every row's envelope from the history and, beside it, the row's step from steps.jsonl (harness replay --steps; history.schema.json steps): each actor whose state it changed, before and after, the context fields it changed, the effects it queued with their acks, its route, or why replay could not apply it (V2).
